title: 输出与格式化
source:
# 修改变量，观察格式化输出
name = '小明'
score = 88.5
print(f'{name}：{score:.1f} 分')

title: 读取用户输入
source:
# 输入会显示在控制台，输入后点击发送
name = input('你叫什么名字？')
print('你好，' + name)

title: 条件判断
match / case
source:
command = ['add', 3, 4]
match command:
    case ['add', a, b]:
        print(a + b)
    case _:
        print('未知命令')

title: 变量交换
source:
a, b = 3, 8
a, b = b, a
print(a, b)

title: 程序入口
for 循环
source:
for item in range(5):
    print(item)

title: while 倒计时
source:
remaining = 3
while remaining > 0:
    print(remaining)
    remaining -= 1  # 每次更新，避免死循环

title: enumerate 编号
zip 配对
source:
names = ['小明', '小红']
scores = [80, 90]
for name, score in zip(names, scores, strict=True):
    print(name, score)

title: 列表推导式
source:
numbers = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
squares = [n * n for n in numbers if n % 2 == 0]
print(squares)

title: 字典统计
定义并调用函数
source:
def square(number):
    return number * number

# return 不会打印；调用后用 print 显示
print(square(6))

title: 默认与关键字参数
可变参数
lambda 排序
source:
students = [('小明', 80), ('小红', 95)]
ranked = sorted(students, key=lambda student: student[1], reverse=True)
print(ranked)

title: 类与方法
dataclass 数据类
读取 UTF-8 文本
安全写入文本
source:
# x 模式只创建新文件，避免覆盖已有内容
try:
    with open('notes.txt', 'x', encoding='utf-8') as file:
        file.write('你好，Python！\n')
    print('已创建 notes.txt')
except FileExistsError:
    print('文件已存在，请修改名称后重试')

title: 读取 JSON
source:
import json

text = '{"name":"小明","score":88}'
data = json.loads(text)
print(data['name'], data['score'])

title: 生成 JSON
source:
import json

data = {'name': '小明', 'score': 88}
text = json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
print(text)

title: 读取 CSV
source:
import csv
from io import StringIO

text = 'name,score\n小明,88\n小红,95'
for row in csv.DictReader(StringIO(text)):
    print(row['name'], int(row['score']))

title: pathlib 文件路径
source:
from pathlib import Path

# 项目脚本可用 Path(__file__).parent 定位同目录
path = Path('data') / 'scores.csv'
print('文件名：', path.name)
print('扩展名：', path.suffix)

title: 异常处理
Counter 计数
source:
from collections import Counter

counts = Counter('banana')
for character, count in sorted(counts.items()):
    print(character, count)

title: 正则提取数字
source:
import re

text = '订单12，数量3，总价99'
numbers = re.findall(r'\d+', text)
print(numbers)

title: 日期计算
source:
from datetime import date, timedelta

today = date.today()
print('今天：', today.isoformat())
print('七天后：', (today + timedelta(days=7)).isoformat())

title: unittest 函数测试
async / await
source:
import asyncio

async def greet(name):
    await asyncio.sleep(0)
    return '你好，' + name

async def main():
    result = await greet('小明')
    print(result)

asyncio.run(main())
